title: K-flat finite models for strict quotient expressions
statement: theorem quotientExpressionKFlatModels {Z X Y : Scheme.{t}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hlZ : ∀ x : Z, IsUnit (l : Z.residueField x)) (hlX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.residueField x)) (hlY : ∀ x : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.residueField x)) (r : ℕ) (P : Fin r → CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ) (hP : ∀ i : Fin r, CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y) (P i)) (hflat : ∀ (i : Fin r) (k : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y) ((P i).X k)) : ∃ (N : Fin r → Complex l E Y) (κ : ∀ (i : Fin r) (n : ℕ), level l E (N i) n ≅ ((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (P i)), (∀ (i : Fin r) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : n ≤ m), transition l E (N i) hmn ≫ ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E Y hmn).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (κ i n).hom = (κ i m).hom ≫ (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (coefficientOrdinaryQuotient l E Y hmn) (.up ℤ)).app (P i)) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin r) (n : ℕ), ∃ e : (coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E Y n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (P i)) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (level l E (N i) n), e.hom = (coefficientFiniteReductionModel l E Y (P i) (hP i) n).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (κ i n).inv) ∧ ∀ (W : Scheme.{t}) (K : Complex l E W), Generated l E h f N W K → ∀ n : ℕ, Good l E K n
